_note: Synthetic, fail-closed field map for a cancer pathology synoptic scaffold. Applicability depends on the exact current CAP protocol for the organ and specimen, which a qualified pathologist selects. This file was authored as a reconstruction from SKILL.md and references/diagnostic_reports_standards.md; it is deliberately not a generic cancer staging checklist.
not_for_use: DRAFT - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE, SIGNATURE, FILING, OR SUBMISSION. Populate only from verified authorized source records. Qualified review and sign-off are required.

route.primary_guidance: current specimen-specific CAP Cancer Protocol (selected by a qualified pathologist)

synoptic_data_elements.note: Core and conditionally required data elements are represented as data-element / response pairs. The set that applies depends on the exact current protocol above. Populate only from the CAP protocol in force for this specimen.

observations.note: Observations are transcribed as attributed facts. This template never generates a gross or microscopic observation.

indeterminate_values.note: Do not convert 'cannot be determined' or 'not applicable' into a definitive value.

pending_human_reviews.domain: diagnosis, grade, stage, margins, biomarker interpretation
